page: Google Cloud Platform c3d-highmem-90-lssd is a memory-optimized server instance from the c3d family. It features 90 dedicated vCPUs powered by an AMD EPYC 9B14 processor with an x86_64 architecture, containing 45 physical cores and 2 threads per core. The system is equipped with 720 GB of RAM, providing 8.0 GB of memory per core. For local storage, the instance includes 3216 GB of NVMe SSD capacity distributed across 8 local SSDs.

In benchmark evaluations, this server demonstrates top-tier multi-core CPU performance, ranking in the top 10% for stress-ng multi-core tests, PassMark CPU scores, and software compilation using Clang. Single-core performance is strong, placing in the top 25% for stress-ng single-core tests. Memory bandwidth is also highly capable, with read-only operations for both small and large blocks scoring in the top 25%, though large-block write bandwidth remains in the average tier. Cryptographic capabilities are notable, with PassMark encryption tests scoring in the top 10%, supported by hardware-level AES and SHA instruction sets.

Given its high memory density, dedicated AMD EPYC processing power, and fast local NVMe SSD storage, this instance is well-suited for memory-intensive databases, large-scale software compilation, and data-dense workloads. It also shows strong performance in LLM prompt processing for small and medium models. From a resource density perspective, the combination of high-capacity RAM and integrated local NVMe storage offers a consolidated hardware profile for enterprise database operations and high-throughput web serving without requiring external storage attachments.
